name: Item scaling: a chest opened by a level-scaled character holds its items lifted to the character's content level
contract: Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1, DestinyWeaver.LevelScaling=1, DestinyWeaver.Scaling.Offset=3 and CoA.ItemScaling=1. Defias Turncoat's Jerkin 1345037 holds Defias Turncoat's Jerkin 500815 (green, not Worldforged) at 100%, authored at item level 10 and required level 5 with 36 armor, which this realm places at item level 8 and required level 4. A level 30 character with open-world scaling on meets content at level 27, so the jerkin it loots must be a copy lifted by 15 levels: item level 23, required level 19 and more armor than the authored 36. With scaling off, Underbed Glint 90550 holds the Rootbark Girdle 521000 itself, which this realm places at item level 8. Lock, key and skill checks of the chest are not exercised; client rendering of the copy is not tested.

steps.label: The chest holds a copy of Defias Turncoat's Jerkin
The copy is lifted to item level 23, fifteen above the eight this realm gives the jerkin
The copy carries more armor than the authored 36
The looted copy keeps item level 23
The looted copy requires level 19, fifteen above the four this realm asks for the jerkin
The unscaled chest holds the Rootbark Girdle itself
The unlifted item keeps the item level this realm gives it, 8
